hints.title: Vertex Disjoint Paths
hints.text: A matrix cannot be disconnected by 1 flip if and only if there exist at least two vertex-disjoint paths from top-left to bottom-right.

hints.title: Path Invalidation
hints.text: Find an initial path from (0, 0) to (m - 1, n - 1). If no path exists, it is already disconnected.

hints.title: Secondary Path Search
hints.text: Mutate all intermediate cells along the first path to 0, then check if another valid path still exists.

hints.title: Two-Pass DFS Path Invalidation Implementation

complexity.notes: At most two graph traversals over m * n grid cells.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating flipping every cell and re-running path checks takes O(m^2 * n^2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses max-flow / vertex cut property: checks if there are 2 vertex-disjoint paths by erasing the first path found.
